name: Roxmore Resources Inc.
summary: Roxmore Resources Inc., an investment company, engages in investing in life sciences, mining, industrial, and technology industries in Canada. The company holds 100% interest in the Converse Gold Project, located within the prolific battle mountain. It explores gold, fe-oxides, chalcopyrite, and pyrrhotite. The company was formerly known as Axcap Ventures Inc. and changed its name to Roxmore Resources Inc. in November 2025. The company is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
